description: This file defines the 'Xlsx' class, a core component of the PhpSpreadsheet library responsible for reading XLSX spreadsheet files. It includes methods for file validation, loading, parsing XML content within ZIP archives, extracting sheet data, styles, shared strings, comments, hyperlinks, and other worksheet elements. The class establishes the foundation for reading structured spreadsheet data from XLSX files and converting it into PhpSpreadsheet's internal data structures.

classes.name: Xlsx
classes.description: This class handles reading XLSX files in the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing methods to validate, load, and parse Excel spreadsheet data without fully loading into memory. It manages temporary ZIP and XML processing, styles, shared strings, comments, hyperlinks, and worksheet data extraction.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Determines if the specified XLSX file can be read by this reader, based on file presence and structure.

methods.name: listWorksheetNames
methods.description: Returns an array of worksheet names present in the XLSX file without loading the entire spreadsheet.

methods.name: listWorksheetInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed info about worksheets in the XLSX, such as name, last column, total rows, and columns, without fully loading the spreadsheet.

methods.name: loadSpreadsheetFromFile
methods.description: Loads the entire XLSX spreadsheet into a PhpSpreadsheet Spreadsheet object, parsing styles, shared strings, comments, and data.

methods.name: readAutoFilter
methods.description: Loads the auto filter settings from the specified XML sheet element into the worksheet object.

methods.name: readTables
methods.description: Detects and processes table parts within the XML sheet, delegating to load individual tables from relationship files.

methods.name: readTablesInTablesFile
methods.description: Loads individual table XML parts from ZIP archive files and populates the worksheet with table data.

methods.name: extractStyles
methods.description: Extracts style nodes from an XML sheet element into an array.

methods.name: extractPalette
methods.description: Extracts color palette information from the XML styles XML.

methods.name: processIgnoredErrors
methods.description: Parses 'ignoredErrors' XML attributes and applies corresponding error ignore settings to worksheet cells.

methods.name: storeFormulaAttributes
methods.description: Stores formula-related attributes from XML into the worksheet cell object.

search-terms: shared strings and styles in XLSX
